summary: I02a implemented: real PostgreSQL/Flyway V2/generated-jOOQ registration, email/password login, safe authenticated identity and idempotent token revocation through stateless Spring Security. Pinned Unicode15.1 names/IDNA email keys are separate from exact whitespace/Unicode passwords; versioned Argon2id salts, two hash permits, successful legacy rehash, bounded rate limits and hashed-only random persistent nonexpiring tokens with revocation/account epochs are exercised. Twenty-seven distinct affected shared/server tests pass across the initial run and targeted rechecks, plus the actual incremental local image entry/restart/revoke journey; original failed outputs remain diagnostics, not claimed whole-suite passes. A host-only Argon2id sample averages 173ms/hash, not physical Android performance. evidenceNotes: Captured command outputs retain their .txt paths but are lossless JSON envelopes with command, actual exitCode, outputSha256 and original output string, preserving trailing whitespace/CR bytes without failing staged whitespace checks; handoff.txt is plain current audit output. Initial/affected JUnit XML is retained as JSON strings; final process XML is included verbatim as a JSON string in the handoff audit. Original red commands remain red diagnostics; the audit reconciles 27 individually green tests and explicitly does not call either partial red command a full green run. No full-suite/clean-build/unchanged platform matrix was run.
diagnosticDisposition: Initial generator expected only V1 and generated only service_writer. Add V2 explicitly to expected migrated history/generated account/session table inventory; subsequent locked JVM build and actual generated-field repository/image checks pass.
Kotlin compile identified Spring Security/encoder nullable APIs. Use explicit non-null checks at invariant boundaries; subsequent locked JVM21 compilation passes.

Initial unauthorized HTTP checks exposed Spring Security's default HttpSessionRequestCache creating Set-Cookie on error. Use NullRequestCache with NullSecurityContextRepository; all four real HTTP tests pass on recheck without cookie creation.

Rate-capacity test wrongly counted expired existing windows as permanently occupied. Use a dedicated same-window 10,000-key capacity assertion, then assert real expiry recovery; production rate limiter unchanged and targeted check passes.

Affected process-schema test still expected a one-row migration history after V2. Update exact preserved history counts and future migration rank/version; isolated process recheck passes. Corresponding full image-matrix history expectations are updated, with that unchanged broad matrix retained for I34 rather than rerun here.

New dependency provenance helper initially assumed direct POM licenses, then assumed every missing license had a parent. Retain ICU's inherited Unicode/ICU license and Bouncy Castle's exact r1rv84 upstream MIT-style license; final provenance check passes. The filename dependencies-passing.txt belongs to the second FAILED diagnostic, not a pass. No release/legal clearance is claimed.
